title: Quantification of mirtazapine in tablets via DNA binding mechanism; development of a new HPLC method.
authors: Kuzpinar, Ecem; Al Faysal, Abdullah; Senel, Pelin; Erdogan, Taner; Golcu, Aysegul
journal: Journal of chromatography. B, Analytical technologies in the biomedical and life sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文开发HPLC方法并研究抗抑郁药米氮平与dsDNA的小沟结合机制，含分子对接和MD模拟，虽非TF-DNA体系但属蛋白-DNA互作的可迁移方法，故给5分。
abstract: Atypical antidepressant mirtazapine (MIR) is mostly prescribed for the management of major depressive disorder. The identification of MIR in pharmaceutical dosage forms was made possible by developing a novel, quick, sensitive high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) approach that was verified in accordance with ICH recommendations. In the first part of this study, HPLC investigations were optimized with regard to variables including pH, working column, mobile phase, temperature, and flow rate. The limit of detection (LOD) was 0.013 ppm, the limit of quantification (LOQ) was 0.044 ppm, and the linear range was computed as 0.5-15 ppm (R(2) = 0.9998). The recovery investigation assessed the method's accuracy, which was shown to range between 98.82 and 100.97 %. In the second part, by using UV-vis spectroscopy, HPLC, thermal denaturation, and viscosity measurements, the mechanism of binding interaction of MIR with double-stranded fish sperm deoxyribonucleic acid (dsDNA) has been thoroughly studied. The DNA binding constants (K(b)) were determined using UV-Vis absorption and HPLC methods. To investigate the interactions of MIR with dsDNA, molecular docking calculations and additionally, molecular dynamics simulations were performed. Results showed that MIR is located in the minor groove of dsDNA, and in addition to hydrogen bonding, electrostatic interaction is also formed between the aromatic ring of MIR and phosphate oxygen of dsDNA. Finally, a binding characterization study using MIR tablets was also conducted in order to assess the interaction mechanism of the DNA with the drug using the validated analytical procedure developed for the MIR molecule.
abstract_zh: 非典型抗抑郁药米氮平（MIR）主要用于治疗重度抑郁症。通过开发一种新颖、快速、灵敏的高效液相色谱（HPLC）方法，并依据ICH建议进行验证，实现了对药物剂型中MIR的鉴定。在本研究的第一部分，对HPLC实验中的变量（包括pH、工作柱、流动相、温度和流速）进行了优化。检测限（LOD）为0.013 ppm，定量限（LOQ）为0.044 ppm，线性范围计算为0.5-15 ppm（R(2) = 0.9998）。回收率实验评估了该方法的准确性，结果显示其范围在98.82%至100.97%之间。在第二部分，通过使用紫外-可见光谱、HPLC、热变性和粘度测量，对MIR与双链鱼精脱氧核糖核酸（dsDNA）的结合相互作用机制进行了深入研究。使用紫外-可见吸收和HPLC方法测定了DNA结合常数（K(b)）。为探究MIR与dsDNA的相互作用，进行了分子对接计算以及分子动力学模拟。结果表明，MIR位于dsDNA的小沟中，除了氢键作用外，MIR的芳香环与dsDNA的磷酸氧之间还形成了静电相互作用。最后，使用MIR片剂进行了结合表征研究，以利用为MIR分子开发的已验证分析程序评估药物与DNA的相互作用机制。
